sections.description: Kiosk mode module for Patlis sites.
sections.changelog:
1.0.12

  • Added compatibility with the Patlis custom updater flow.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin on any WordPress site?

No, this plugin is designed specifically for Patlis platform websites.

What does this plugin do?

It provides kiosk mode behavior including slide display and inactivity redirect logic.

Is this plugin required?

Only for sites that use the kiosk feature set.

Where can I configure kiosk behavior?

Use the Kiosk Mode settings page in WordPress admin.
